info.name: BeryBox Backend API
info.description: Postman collection for testing BeryBox Server based strictly on Backend PRD & API Contract.

item.name: 00 - Setup & Authentication
item.description: Run seeded-account logins first. Each login saves its role-specific token and makes it the current access_token.

request.description: Register returns the user only; it intentionally does not return an access token. Re-running with the same fixture returns a duplicate error.

exec: pm.test("Register does not return a token", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json()).not.to.have.property("access_token"); });

item.name: 01 - Users
item.description: Authenticated public-profile lookup. Private identity and coordinate fields must remain hidden.

exec: pm.test("Private fields are hidden", function () { const json = pm.response.json(); ["email", "password", "latitude", "longitude"].forEach(function (field) { pm.expect(json).not.to.have.property(field); }); });

item.name: 02 - ImageKit
item.description: Retrieves client upload authentication parameters; no private key is returned.

exec: pm.test("ImageKit auth fields are present and private key is absent", function () { const json = pm.response.json(); ["token", "expire", "signature"].forEach(function (field) { pm.expect(json).to.have.property(field); }); pm.expect(json).not.to.have.property("privateKey"); });

item.name: 03 - Items
item.description: Create and inspect an Alice-owned item. DELETE Item - Run Last is destructive to later claim/offer flows and should only be run after dependent scenarios.

exec: pm.test("Nearby response is public and distance is numeric", function () { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json).to.be.an("array"); json.forEach(function (item) { pm.expect(item).not.to.have.property("latitude"); pm.expect(item).not.to.have.property("longitude"); if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(item, "distanceKm")) pm.expect(item.distanceKm).to.be.a("number"); }); });

request.description: Set imageKitExampleUrl to a URL returned by an upload using this project's IMAGEKIT_URL_ENDPOINT before running this request.

exec: pm.test("Detail has shipping and claim metadata", function () { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json).to.have.property("suggestedShipping"); pm.expect(json).to.have.property("pendingClaimCount"); });

request.description: Run only after all claim, organization-offer, conversation, report, and review scenarios that use this item.

exec: pm.test("Item was soft-cancelled", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.eql({ message: "Item cancelled" }); });

item.name: 04 - Requests - Claim
item.description: Flow: create an available public item owned by Alice -> Bob claims -> Alice accepts -> either participant completes -> review becomes available.

request.description: shippingMethod must be one of the methods returned by suggestedShipping for the item distance.

item.name: 05 - Requests - Organization Offer
item.description: Run 07 - Organizations -> Create Organization Profile and 11 - Admin -> Approve Organization before testing a successful org_offer. The offered item must still be available.

item.name: 06 - Requests - Barter
item.description: Flow: create two available barter items owned by different users -> Alice creates request -> Bob rejects -> Alice may redeem with credit. To test direct acceptance, recreate the request and accept using Bob.

item.name: 07 - Organizations
item.description: Panti is an organization-role account. On seeded data its profile may already exist and remain pending until an admin approves it.

request.description: Intended for a fresh database/manual scenario. Seeded data may already contain the Panti profile, in which case the contract response is 400 Organization already exists.

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Panti Asuhan Melati",
  "type": "orphanage",
  "description": "Panti untuk anak sekolah dasar di Bandung.",
  "latitude": -6.91,
  "longitude": 107.6
}

exec: pm.test("Created or seeded profile already exists", function () { pm.expect([201, 400]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
if (pm.response.code === 201) { const json = pm.response.json(); if (json.id) pm.collectionVariables.set("organizationId", json.id); }

item.name: 08 - Conversations
item.description: REST persists and retrieves messages. Realtime behavior uses Socket.io events join_conversation, send_message, new_message, and new_notification; these are not HTTP endpoints.

item.name: 09 - Reviews
item.description: Reviews are accepted only after the referenced request is completed, once per participant.

item.name: 10 - Reports
item.description: Authenticated users can report existing items, users, or organizations. New reports always have open status.

item.name: 11 - Admin
item.description: All requests in this folder use the seeded admin token. Approve Panti before a successful organization-offer flow.

exec: const panti = organizations.find(function (organization) { return organization.userId === pantiUserId; });

request.description: Alternative moderation action. Do not run after approval if the organization-offer scenario still needs approved state.

item.name: 12 - AI
item.description: AI suggestions are still derived only from approved organizations and available public items in the database. If Gemini is unavailable or quota is exhausted, the backend contract returns 502 AI service unavailable.

exec: pm.test("Response has reply", function () { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json).to.have.property("reply"); });
pm.test("Response has suggestions", function () { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json).to.have.property("suggestions"); pm.expect(json.suggestions).to.be.an("array"); });

item.name: 13 - Negative Tests
item.description: Manual failure scenarios. Some requests require the indicated fixture/state to be prepared first.

exec: pm.test("Error message is correct", function () { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json).to.have.property("message", "Invalid email or password"); });
pm.test("Error message is correct", function () { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json).to.have.property("message", "Invalid token"); });
pm.test("Error message is correct", function () { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json).to.have.property("message", "Invalid token"); });
